Fixturely is a small team in Lyon. We spent eight years as freelance designers before we wrote a line of code for this.

We don't sell to agencies with a finance department. We build for the people who send the invoice and then wait for it.

Our rule for every reminder is simple to state. It should read like a note you'd send yourself, with your name at the bottom and no threat in it.

We answer every support email ourselves, usually within a day.
